g1.label: 1. Who makes the announcement?
g1.why: The recording says the head teacher is making the announcement.

g2.label: 2. When is the uniform compulsory?
g2.why: The recording says the uniform becomes compulsory after the summer holidays.

g3.label: 3. What colour is the sweatshirt?
g3.why: The recording says the sweatshirt is dark blue with the school logo.

g4.label: 4. Where can families buy it?
g4.why: The recording says families can order from the online shop on the school website.

g5.label: 5. What help is offered to poorer families?
g5.why: The recording says there will be a free second-hand uniform exchange.

g6.label: 6. Hannah's reason for liking the uniform?
g6.why: The recording says Hannah likes that there will be less pressure about wearing the right clothes.

g7.label: 7. Leo's main worry?
g7.why: The recording says Leo worries everyone will look the same and lose their identity.

g8.label: 8. What do they agree to do?
g8.why: The recording says they agree to write down their views and hand them in.

g1.label: 1. Elif — hates spending on fashion
g1.why: The text says the fairness view means nobody is judged for cheap or expensive clothes.

g2.label: 2. Marco — unusual outfits, personality
g2.why: The text says clothes are how self-expression shows who you are.

g3.label: 3. Sena — no time to think about clothes
g3.why: The text says a uniform saves time deciding what to wear.

g4.label: 4. Paul — move and sit easily
g4.why: The text says comfort means not wearing stiff, uncomfortable clothes.

g5.label: 5. Trainers in every lesson
g5.why: The text says trainers are only allowed in PE lessons.

g6.label: 6. Own coat outside on cold days
g6.why: The text confirms your own coat may be worn outside on cold days.

g7.label: 7. Lots of jewellery allowed
g7.why: The text says only small earrings are permitted; other jewellery stays at home.

g8.label: 8. Sweatshirt has the school logo
g8.why: The text confirms the school sweatshirt must show the school logo.
